prompt: In this codebase, how are TLS certificates generated on the fly for intercepted hosts? Name the class responsible and the file it lives in.
How does the proxy replay previously saved requests from the client side? Name the addon class that implements it.
When a new connection arrives, how does the proxy decide which protocol layer (TLS, HTTP, TCP passthrough, ...) to use next? Name the addon that makes that decision.
How can a user make the proxy refuse requests to certain hosts with a status code instead of forwarding them? Name the addon class and the option.
How does the proxy serve a response from a local file on disk instead of contacting the server? Name the addon class and its option.
Where is authentication of proxy clients (username/password before allowing them through the proxy) implemented? Name the class.
Which class models a single HTTP request/response exchange flowing through the proxy, and which module defines it?
Which option makes the proxy write flows to a file continuously as they happen, and which addon class handles it?
The console UI has a command language. Which third-party library is used to parse command input, and which module does the lexing?
How does the proxy pause flows so a user can edit them before they continue? Name the addon class and the option that holds the filter.
What feature re-attaches cookies previously seen for a host to new requests, and which class implements it?
Where is the WebSocket protocol handled inside the proxy's layer stack? Give the module path.
